strategy: Elf self-mill mass reanimation — Bloodline Bidding
identity: A BG Elf deck that treats its own graveyard as a second battlefield and then moves it. Bloodline Bidding reads 'Convoke ... Choose a creature type. Return all creature cards of the chosen type from your graveyard to the battlefield' — and 14 of the 40 cards in this list are Elf creature cards, every one of which the mill suite is trying to bin. Ten enabler copies fill the pile while Creakwood Safewright, a deathtouch Trystan and two deathtouch Virulent Emissary hold the ground, and convoke means the surviving board pays for most of the eight mana. The discipline that defines the build is negative: with one stated exception, nothing in the 40 returns a creature card from the graveyard to hand or exiles one — which is why Morcant's Loyalist, Graveshifter, Trystan's Command, Champions of the Perfect and Stoic Grove-Guide are all absent despite being strong cards in this colour pair. Because the pool allows only one Bloodline Bidding, Morcant's Eyes x2 is the structurally different backup (an enchantment, cashed at sorcery speed, off the same pile) and Dose of Dawnglow is a single-target instant-speed version of the same conversion.

restrictions.build_constraint: at most 5 rare/mythic cards total across mainboard + sideboard

Return all creature cards of the chosen type from your graveyard to the battlefield', y 14 de las 40 cartas de esta lista son cartas de criatura Elfo, cada una de las cuales el paquete de molienda intenta enterrar. Diez copias de habilitadores llenan el montón mientras Creakwood Safewright, un Trystan con toque mortal y dos Virulent Emissary con toque mortal sostienen el suelo, y el convoke hace que el tablero superviviente pague la mayor parte de los ocho manás. La disciplina que define la construcción es negativa: con una excepción declarada, nada de las 40 devuelve una carta de criatura del cementerio a la mano ni exilia una, que es por lo que Morcant's Loyalist, Graveshifter, Trystan's Command, Champions of the Perfect y Stoic Grove-Guide están todas ausentes pese a ser cartas fuertes en esta pareja de colores. Como el pool permite solo un Bloodline Bidding, Morcant's Eyes x2 es el respaldo estructuralmente distinto (un encantamiento, cobrado a velocidad de conjuro, desde el mismo montón) y Dose of Dawnglow es una versión de objetivo único a velocidad de instantáneo de la misma conversión.
